hypothesis: A dropout-disabled miniature PyTorch/ROCm realization can reproduce LibNC causal segment predictions and Adam-updated parameters from identical frozen coefficients closely enough to authorize full-profile teacher tracing.
interfaces_exposed: LibNC coefficient export, causal segment state, named Adam update receipt
kill_condition: Stop the current port if the first update diverges after matching loss reduction, clipping, Adam state, learning rate, and memory schedule; do not launch a mature trace on inference parity alone.
promotion_condition: Across a fixed miniature causal schedule, every pre-update and post-update distribution remains within the declared F32/BF16 tolerance and named parameter updates match before any full-profile trace.
retired_neighborhoods: startup teacher quotient and soft-target feature sweeps
title: NNCP v3.3 ROCm online-update parity
